_comment: WHOIS REGISTRANT NOISE, KB / ANALYST SIDE. Same purpose as WebPivot/references/registrant_noise.json but consumed by the INGEST + HYPOTHESIS layer, where a bad value is far more expensive: an unfiltered 'Domain Admin' becomes a high-confidence `registered_by -> person` edge and silently merges every domain whose registrar used that placeholder into one operator. Before this file the same lists were pasted into ingest_webpivot.py, clean_kb.py, hypothesize.py and ingest_report.py and had drifted apart. Companion file: noise_filters.json (shared INFRASTRUCTURE rather than registrant identity).

org_suffixes._comment: Corporate suffixes that mean the registrant NAME is an organisation, not a natural person — the record is routed to entity type 'org' instead of 'person'. Matched as a substring of ' ' + lowercased name, so each entry carries its own leading space.

name_junk._comment: WHOIS field-label and registry-status text that a parser mis-captures as a registrant name ('Registrant State', 'Redemption Period'). Matched as a case-insensitive substring; a hit means the name is discarded entirely, not reclassified.

role_name_placeholders._comment: Generic registrant ROLE placeholders. Distinct from privacy_markers, which matches privacy-SIGNALLING words; these strings contain no such word so that rule misses them. Matched on the NORMALISED name (lowercased, punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed) and EXACTLY, never as a substring — a substring rule would eat real registrants like 'Admin Solutions GmbH'. Exactness is the safety property: over-filtering destroys real attribution, which is the costlier direction.

privacy_markers._comment: Substrings marking a registrant name/org as privacy-proxied or redacted. Consumed by ingest_webpivot when deciding whether a registrant is linkable.

proxy_email_domains._comment: Email domains run by a privacy proxy or registrar. Matched against the part after '@'.

proxy_email_tokens._comment: Substrings anywhere in an email that mark it as a proxy/registrar/role address. Broader and fuzzier than proxy_email_domains so it catches the long tail of providers nobody enumerated. Consumed by hypothesize._is_proxy — a hit means the indicator never drives a hypothesis.

placeholder_person_markers._comment: Substrings marking a registrant PERSON value as a placeholder rather than an owner. Consumed by hypothesize when scoring an attribution chain.

junk_hash_prefixes._comment: Hash prefixes that are parser artifacts, not fingerprints — sha1/sha256/md5 of the EMPTY string (an empty favicon or empty DOM), plus known mis-parses. A cluster built on one of these is a cluster of 'we failed to fetch anything', which is the single most common false-cluster source in the KB.

report_noise_domains._comment: Domains that must never become an investigation TARGET when harvested out of a pasted report or PDF — the platforms every report mentions in passing. Matched exact-or-parent. Consumed by ingest_report.extract.

report_filename_suffixes._comment: File extensions that make a token look like a domain but mean it is a FILENAME ('assessment.md', 'graph.png'). Consumed by ingest_report.extract to reject them before the domain regex claims them.
